author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (documents)

prerequisites: Signed-in fictional role in its own browser context on the work documentation lab; the Business User signed in with a new magic link read from the lab Mailpit.

Reviewer-built fixtures: a two-page text PDF, Word and PowerPoint files, an image-only scan, a PNG, an EML with a remote image and PDF and Word attachments, CSV and ZIP files, and a Word file with a malformed ZIP container.

For the Business User: a walkthrough-created Contract with Jonas Weber on its team, a two-Version Document, an archived Document, full-thread comment attachments, the Business User's own Request with an attachment, and a published everyone-audience Knowledge Item whose primary Document was uploaded second.
scenarios.expected: Supported renditions/text become available and downloads preserve the original bytes. Failure/unsupported states offer the documented download or recovery path; portal file reach is checked separately.
scenarios.actual: 7 recorded browser steps passed for this role. The PDF name opened the reader with its title, v1 and Page 1 of 2; Previous page, Next page, Zoom out, Zoom in and Find in document worked and Find read "1 of 2"; Download returned the uploaded bytes and Close the document closed the reader. Word and PowerPoint renditions became ready and opened as PDF pages while the downloads stayed the uploaded files and the chains stayed at one Version. The image-only scan showed Page 1 of 1, Find read "No matches", the text read-back became ready from OCR, and global search listed the scan. The PNG drew inline. The EML showed From, To, Subject, Date, the body and "2 attachments" with no remote image request; the PDF attachment previewed and the Word attachment downloaded. CSV and ZIP names downloaded directly and a reader link showed the download-only card. With the rendition held at pending the reader showed "Preparing this document for reading…" and Download worked. The malformed Word file reached failed, showed "This file could not be prepared for reading here. Download it to read it." and downloaded its original; a readable v2 rendered while v1 kept the failure card in the chain.

prerequisites: Signed-in fictional role in its own browser context on the work documentation lab; the Business User signed in with a new magic link read from the lab Mailpit.

Reviewer-built fixtures: a two-page text PDF, Word and PowerPoint files, an image-only scan, a PNG, an EML with a remote image and PDF and Word attachments, CSV and ZIP files, and a Word file with a malformed ZIP container.

For the Business User: a walkthrough-created Contract with Jonas Weber on its team, a two-Version Document, an archived Document, full-thread comment attachments, the Business User's own Request with an attachment, and a published everyone-audience Knowledge Item whose primary Document was uploaded second.
scenarios.expected: Supported renditions/text become available and downloads preserve the original bytes. Failure/unsupported states offer the documented download or recovery path; portal file reach is checked separately.
scenarios.actual: 7 recorded browser steps passed for this role. In the Portal Contract's Documents section, the Document name opened the reader on the current v2 and the download beside it returned the uploaded bytes. "1 earlier version" listed v1, which opened in the reader and downloaded. The archived Document was not listed and a Contract without team membership showed "Contract not found" (404). The Request attachment under Attachments downloaded its original bytes without a reader. In Comments, the PDF and Word attachments opened previews with Download, a ZIP attachment showed "Preview unavailable. You can download the original file." with Download, and no filing action was offered. The Knowledge page listed the primary Document first with Download beside each file and no reader; after Legal archived the item its address returned to the Portal home with no files. /documents was not available and the repository read answered 403.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the article author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
The pending state used a browser-network fixture on the rendition read; the failed state used a real failed conversion of a malformed Word container. The doc-engine was not stopped.
Word tracked changes and comments were not in the fixtures, so their rendering was not checked.
The fixture email's remote image had no source after server sanitising, so the check shows that no remote request was made, not how an allowed image would behave.
A Word comment attachment opened as a converted preview in the Portal; the "Preview unavailable" message was observed with a ZIP attachment. The article states that message conditionally.
Global search and OCR ran on the shared lab's worker; timings are not claimed.
The shared work lab was used by other agents at the same time; only records named DOC-029 documents ... were created.

compatibilityReview.summary: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38 and found no change to Document, Version, folder, preview, repository, archive or delete behavior or labels; the only Document-surface change is the archived uploader color. I replayed the round 1 documents walkthrough on the work2 lab built from 57e77e38, and all 117 steps passed for Administrator, Legal Team Member and Business User.
